_purpose: Machine-readable ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9b comparative case table: one row per CE100-CE200 space-cooling equipment case, each carrying its transcribed IEA SHC Task 22 comparative evidence band(s) or an explicit missing-band note. GENERATED by scripts/generate_section9b_cases.py - do not hand-edit; regenerate. Issue #4273.
_scope: The ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9.3 comparative test series is not implemented in this tree. This table scores the CE cases against transcribed Task-22 evidence ranges only, in the sense that it attaches the published range to each case: it does not run the comparative test series, it does not score an engine output, and it derives no verdict. Standard 140 defines no pass/fail criterion for these ranges.
_band_kind: comparative evidence range, not a pass/fail criterion
_no_pass_fail_criterion: Standard 140 defines no pass/fail criterion for the Task-22 comparative ranges. Every band in this table is labelled 'comparative evidence range, not a pass/fail criterion'. No band is fitted to fluxion's output, widened, interpolated between cases, or replaced by a flat percentage across cases.

_units.recorded: MWh (energy), kW (power), C (temperature), as recorded in the bounds CSV
_units.normalisation: The SI endpoints use exactly the conversions the Rust loader applies (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/reference_data.rs, to_si): MWh -> J x 1.0e6 x 3600.0, kW -> W x 1.0e3, C -> K + 273.15. Both the recorded and the SI value/unit are emitted.

bounds_csv.header_source_verbatim: IEA SHC Task 22, "HVAC BESTEST, Volume 1: Cases E100-E200, Unitary Space Cooling Equipment." Companion to ASHRAE RP-865 (NREL/TP-5500-66000, 2016, DOI 10.2172/1244668). See data/manifest.json publication "iea_task22_e100". CASE FAMILY: CE100-CE200 — unitary space-cooling equipment (140-2023 identifiers; IEA SHC Task 22 originally published the same cases as E100-E200 — renamed per #4296). CE100-CE140 : dry-coil cases (base + parameter variations) CE150-CE200 : wet-coil cases (latent load added) METHOD: Comparative. `low`/`high` are the qualified-program ensemble (min/max) ranges reported across independently implemented reference programs (EnergyPlus, DOE-2.1E, TRACE 700). These are evidence ranges, not physical constants — see README.md §Comparative testing. UNITS RECORDED: energy in MWh, power in kW, temperature in C. The loader normalizes every value to SI (J, W, K); see reference_data.rs. STATUS: `transcribed` — transcribed from the cited source; flagged for independent re-verification against the primary publication PDF. `mid` is NOT stored: the loader derives mid = 0.5*(low+high) to avoid a redundant, drift-prone column. SCHEMA: case_id,metric,low,high,unit,source_program,program_version,source_table,source_page,status

CASE FAMILY: CE100-CE200 — unitary space-cooling equipment (140-2023 identifiers; IEA SHC Task 22 originally published the same cases as E100-E200 — renamed per #4296). CE100-CE140 : dry-coil cases (base + parameter variations) CE150-CE200 : wet-coil cases (latent load added) METHOD: Comparative. `low`/`high` are the qualified-program ensemble (min/max) ranges reported across independently implemented reference programs (EnergyPlus, DOE-2.1E, TRACE 700). These are evidence ranges, not physical constants — see README.md §Comparative testing. UNITS RECORDED: energy in MWh, power in kW, temperature in C. The loader normalizes every value to SI (J, W, K); see reference_data.rs. STATUS: `transcribed` — transcribed from the cited source; flagged for independent re-verification against the primary publication PDF. `mid` is NOT stored: the loader derives mid = 0.5*(low+high) to avoid a redundant, drift-prone column. SCHEMA: case_id,metric,low,high,unit,source_program,program_version,source_table,source_page,status
